subject: What to use to build nanodisc system?

messages.author: Gustavo Seabra
messages.body:
Hi everyone,
I wonder if anyone here studies nanodiscs, and would be willing to share
their experience in building such systems.
For regular membranes, I very much like to use `packmom-memgen`, but I'm
not sure if it can work with nanodiscs (or at least can't find any mention
in the manual/help).
Any suggestions?
Thanks a lot!
--
Gustavo Seabra.
